headline: $9,002 NP — biggest Thursday in weeks, built on cheap clicks and volume
commentary:
### The day
- **$9,002 NP**, nearly double last Thursday, with margin four points better as well.
  - NP: $9,002 v $4,905 last Thu
  - NM: 16.9% v 12.7%
  - Cost: $44,208 v $33,752
- Volume beat every Thursday of the last eight weeks and lead value held.
  - Processed: 3,171 v 2,861 average
  - EPL: $16.78 v $15.20 average
  - NP v eight-Thursday average: $9,002 v $5,452
- November is miles ahead of October's same days on profit and margin.
  - MTD NP: $39,995 v $26,661
  - MTD NM: 20.3% v 14.9%
### What drove it
- Search bought 47% more clicks and paid less for each one.
  - Clicks: 3,694 v 2,515
  - CPC: $10.80 v $11.22
  - Search cost: $39,904 v $28,212
- Lead value sat in its normal range, so this was a volume day.
  - Search EPL: $24.63 v $23.56 last Thu
  - Search EPL MTD: $26.50
- **albert.com backed off the auction**, which is likely why clicks got cheaper.
  - albert.com account IS: 33.4% v 42.6%
  - Our IS: 11.0% v 10.0%
  - Our abs-top at 20:00: 10.1% v 8.6%
- Bing halved its spend and more than doubled its profit.
  - Bing cost: $2,059 v $3,915
  - Bing NP: $968 v $437
  - Bing EPL: $11.17 v $12.12
### Tests
| Test | Set-up | Spend 05/11 | Spend wk ago | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Off SAs onto tROAS | competitor, tROAS only | $973 | $533 | — |
| Speed | high target, stepping down | $1,839 | $508 | — |
| Scavenger pair | cheap clicks, weekdays only | $1,802 | $847 | — |
- Speed is buying real volume again as it moves off seasonality adjustments.
  - Speed cost: $1,839 v $508
  - Speed CPC: $15.07 v $12.09
- Scavengers doubled their spend and are still picking clicks up cheap.
  - Scavenger cost: $1,802 v $847
  - competitor_scavenger CPC: $3.34
watch: Whether albert's retreat sticks — their account impression share near 33% is what keeps our CPC soft.
Direct (Inc ZP) came in at $18.73 EPL against $20.87 over seven days, so we're tracking the next few days there.
Speed's CPC at $15.07 as its spend scales up from almost nothing.
